title: A Torch on the Path
story: The cliff path was narrow, and the sun was low. Petra and her cousin shared one torch. They marked each fork with stones so they could return. Near the top the wind grew strong and the torch flickered. They crouched behind a rock until the gust passed. Then they reached the viewpoint and saw the sea. They started down before the light was gone.
